svg.title: Pokémon Pikachu Edition
svg.desc: Skin event Pikachu. Varian skin-10 (Black Original Tall Pad): warna pad mengikuti Pokemon, stiker vektor Dream World di pad-5. Layout/ID/hit area/mapping identik. Tanpa script, tanpa aset eksternal.
